procurementNotices.lot_description: Replacement of Cerner/SAP ISH/ISHMED with Epic, including Epic Beaker for laboratory.

procurementNotices.title: Zuyderland Medisch Centrum — nieuw EPD (HiX) ter vervanging van SAP/Cerner ISH/ISHMED
procurementNotices.lot_description: Group-wide EPD replacement across both Zuyderland sites; contract signed 14 Nov 2023, go-live 13 Jun 2025, driven partly by Cerner/SAP's planned withdrawal of ISH/ISHMED from the Dutch market.

procurementNotices.title: UMCG / Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep / Treant Zorggroep — voorgenomen gedeelde uitbreiding Epic-contract (regionaal EPD)
procurementNotices.lot_description: UMCG proposed extending its existing 2015/2016 Epic contract to cover Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep (Scheemda) and Treant Zorggroep (Emmen/Hoogeveen/Stadskanaal), both then on NEXUS. ChipSoft challenged this as an unlawful 'material modification' requiring a fresh EU tender; the Court of Noord-Nederland agreed (2025, imposing a penalty on UMCG and halting the plan), but the Gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden appeals court reversed that ruling on 22 Apr 2026, finding the original 2015 contract already permitted other hospitals to join — clearing the way for the joint rollout (participating hospitals must fully cover their own usage costs). Not yet confirmed live at any of the three OZG/Treant sites as of this report.
